title: Anthropic上市首日受关注 机构称长期潜力仍待观察
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It was a great day yesterday, 17% rally.
I just wonder what you make of both that, but also the shifts today with the shares of Anthropic creeping back down towards the IPO listing price,
segments.zh: 我想知道你怎么看这一点，以及今天Anthropic股价回落至IPO发行价附近，

segments.en: $86 so far this morning. How are you sort of thinking of the past 24 hours in change?
segments.zh: 今早一度到86美元。你如何看待过去24小时的变化？

segments.en: Well, thank you, Danny, for having me back. Good morning to everybody.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，Danny，邀请我回来。大家早上好。

segments.en: So first of all, I want to congratulate the Anthropic team for an outstanding landmark milestone that they have achieved
segments.zh: 首先，我要祝贺Anthropic团队取得了卓越的里程碑成就，

segments.en: and many, many more to come. I think your comments on yesterday versus today, I think it's important to step back and put that in the context.
segments.zh: 未来还会有更多。关于昨天与今天的评论，我认为重要的是退一步看背景。

segments.en: We have had one of the most challenging macro backdrop and despite that, if you look at the success
segments.zh: 我们经历了最具挑战性的宏观背景之一，尽管如此，如果你看成功

segments.en: and Anthropic achieved in their IPO, I mean, somebody else has said it, I'm going to repeat it.
segments.zh: 以及Anthropic在IPO中取得的成就，有人说过，我要重复一下。

segments.en: I actually generally believe this is going to be the first $10 trillion company.
segments.zh: 我确实相信这将成为首家市值10万亿美元的公司。

segments.en: It's a once in a generation type of opportunity.
And but if you look at their IPO, the quality of the demand, the gardener, all the big mutual funds,
segments.zh: 但看看他们的IPO，需求质量很高，包括大型共同基金在内的机构市场参与者，

segments.en: way over subscribed and not only that, upsizing the deal, increasing the pricing above the range
segments.zh: 超额认购严重，不仅如此，还扩大了发行规模，定价高于区间上限，

segments.en: that was on the cover. If you put all that together, it was outstanding.
segments.zh: 那是在封面上的。综合来看，表现非常出色。
